items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: Aaron, I worked with him a long time ago. Mm-hmm. And for a long time as an artist.

ctx.x: As to why that happened. I mean, the two of the biggest forces in New Orleans music. Because you had worked with them for so many years. And I think they're really largely responsible for their success.

Well, the Neville brothers, as a unit, I never worked with. Right. That happened after they come from wherever they were with whoever they were and got together. Mm-hmm. So, I imagine to do that, that in itself takes them away from wherever they were, whoever they were with. Mm-hmm. So, that's all I can see there. I never worked with them as a unit. Aaron, I worked with him a long time ago. Mm-hmm. And for a long time as an artist. Of course, art was with the meters, as the meters. Which, they were a…

Well, I didn't mean that. The Neville brothers is the band, but I should have said it's the individuals. And specifically with the album that supposedly Aaron Neville cut here for Island Records. I think it was going to be called Feelings. Was there an album produced here that is unreleased by him?
